weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared shop login; leaver accounts left active
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-017, G-039
remediation_plan: Onboarding and leaver checklist covering ERP, suite, AI portal, test PC, and shared passwords; named accounts on the shop-floor PC and tablets; monthly reconciliation signed by the Owner; remove 2 stale 2024 suite accounts
milestones: 2026-08-12 stale suite accounts removed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 named shop-floor accounts and first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month); MSP labor (included in contract)

weakness: ERP administrators sign in without MFA; MSP technicians share one firewall administrator login without MFA
remediation_plan: Enforce ERP MFA for all users; separate ERP administrator accounts; MSP replaces the shared firewall login with named logins using MFA and sends screenshots
milestones: 2026-09-15 ERP MFA enforced; 2026-09-30 named MSP firewall logins with MFA
resources_required: MSP labor (about 2 hours); no license cost

weakness: One flat network for office, shop equipment, cameras, and visitors; external interface not monitored
source: P07 (SC-07 objectives); P01 R-001, R-016; P03 G-025, G-048; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Three networks (office, shop equipment wired only, guest); deny-by-default rules between them; firewall logs forwarded to the MSP's log service for 90 days; new Wi-Fi passwords
milestones: 2026-09-30 guest Wi-Fi and new staff password; 2026-11-30 shop equipment network live; 2026-12-31 log forwarding
resources_required: About $900 equipment plus MSP labor (about 6 hours)

weakness: No inventory beyond the MSP's 6 managed computers
remediation_plan: One-page inventory of devices (including test PC, oven controls, winding machine, camera recorder, network equipment), vendors with access, and data locations; reviewed quarterly

weakness: Remote access paths not documented or authorized; internet-exposed remote desktop on the test PC
remediation_plan: Port-forwarding rule removed; test PC administrator password changed; written remote access rules (POL-02 B.7); test set vendor support only through the MSP's attended session tool; quarterly external port scan
milestones: 2026-08-11 rule removed; 2026-08-12 offline malware scan of the test PC (clean); 2026-09-15 password changed; 2026-09-30 first external scan

weakness: Oven OEM modem always on; sessions not approved, monitored, recorded, or ended by the shop
source: P07 (MA-04 objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-018, G-028
remediation_plan: Modem on a keyed switch, powered only for a session the Shop Manager approves; OEM changes credentials and sends a session record; session log kept by the Shop Manager; written OEM remote access terms
milestones: 2026-09-15 keyed switch fitted and modem off; 2026-10-31 OEM credential change and written terms
resources_required: About $150 parts; OEM service visit (already scheduled)

weakness: No ERP export or test PC backup; OT programs not copied; backups deletable by one login and never restored
remediation_plan: Weekly ERP full export to the shared drive; nightly test database copy; OEM exports PLC program, recipes, and HMI project; winding programs copied; backup deletion protected by a separate MFA login; quarterly restore tests
milestones: 2026-09-30 ERP export and first restore test; 2026-10-15 nightly test database copy; 2026-11-30 OT program copies; 2026-12-31 second restore test
resources_required: MSP labor (about 2 hours a quarter); OEM visit

weakness: Test PC runs an unsupported operating system; no firmware review for the firewall or oven; no patch time limits
remediation_plan: Replacement test PC or supported operating system from the test set vendor; patch time limits (critical within 14 days) in the MSP contract; OEM firmware review at the next oven service; firewall firmware with a configuration backup first
milestones: 2026-10-31 vendor quote; 2026-11-30 patch time limits agreed; 2026-12-31 test PC replaced
resources_required: About $2,500 for a replacement test PC and software license (quote pending)

weakness: No malicious code protection on the test PC; USB sticks unscanned; after-hours alerts unseen
source: P07 (SI-03 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 G-029, G-051 to G-053
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on managed computers; offline scan of the test PC monthly until replaced; shop-owned USB sticks scanned before shop use (POL-04 4.9)
milestones: 2026-09-30 USB rule in effect; 2026-12-31 EDR live

weakness: No security or privacy training; no awareness activities
source: P07 (AT-02 objectives); P01 R-001, R-004; P03 G-021
remediation_plan: Annual training for all 7 staff with a payment fraud module and a shop-floor session; quarterly phishing simulations

weakness: No reporting requirement or defined recipients for incident information
source: P07 (IR-06 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 G-033, G-057
remediation_plan: POL-03 4.2 and 4.5 in effect; staff briefing; obligations list and notice templates (cooperative, contracting officer, Florida) in the P08 binder
milestones: 2026-09-01 POL-03 effective; 2026-09-30 staff briefing and templates

weakness: No security or privacy requirements for the MSP, OEMs, or AI vendor; no vendor oversight
remediation_plan: AI vendor data processing addendum barring training use; MSP contract amendment (MFA, 24-hour incident notice, technician list, recovery time); annual vendor review
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI addendum; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment at renewal
resources_required: Owner time; possible MSP price change at renewal

weakness: Leaver access left active 10 weeks; cooperative access notice sent more than two months late
remediation_plan: Leaver checklist with the 1-business-day cooperative notice step (POL-02 B.4); exit confidentiality reminder; badge holders tracked in the obligations list
milestones: 2026-07-16 cooperative notified; 2026-07-20 corrective plan sent; 2026-09-30 checklist in use
